notes.message: Frozen reference vectors and upstream constructor comparison use the same pinned tiktoken implementation; verification establishes profile compatibility and deterministic vectors, not an independent second-tokenizer algorithm. Existing documentation does not claim the latter.

verified_properties: Concurrent reservation uses one RLock and incorporates known charges plus retained unknown maxima.
Timeout/cancellation/partial/sent-without-receipt retain charge uncertainty and reservation; retry leaves prior attempt in denominator.
Exact duplicate receipt is idempotent; cross-attempt/changed receipt identity is rejected.
Observed charge beyond reservedmaximum is preserved as incident and closes new admissions.
Versioned replay reconstructs all events and compares complete record, hashes, summaries and budget incidents.
Vendored vocabulary/merge SHA256 and implementation/runtime versions are checked; controlled bytes and token IDs have independent hashes.
Historical local-v1/v2 preserve null model/tokenizer/usage/cost; sidecar tampering and unknown versions rejected.
Readiness always reports paid_adapter_enabled=false and does not authorize calls; D1 requires32 admitted cases.
Final receipt requires terminal attempt; an early streaming receipt is rejected and the maximum reservation is retained. Root added this guard after review note.
